generator: vole-document pdf-make-large (built into the CLI; encode-time corpus tooling, no library/runtime dependency)
note: No third-party document bytes. large.pdf is assembled in memory by the pinned toolchain from our own deterministic input; the .pdf bytes are gitignored and regenerable from the command below.
reproducibility: Generated twice with identical arguments; the two SHA-256s are equal (byte_reproducible=true).
command: docker compose run --rm --no-TTY dev ./target/debug/vole-document pdf-make-large evidence/corpus/phase7-large 800
stream_encoding: level-0 DEFLATE (stored blocks) inside a real zlib (RFC 1950) wrapper; every stream carries distinct per-stream LCG content, so no plaintext is shared between streams

checks.qpdf_check: rc=0: 'No syntax or stream encoding errors found'
